note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs bill-of-lading rows, not by website claims: aluminium/plastic-tank truck radiators under HS 87089100 shipped from Pithampur ICD (MP) to Jebel Ali (UAE) on 2026-02-28 (BOL 1120731) and to Benapole (Bangladesh) on 2026-02-24 (BOL 9964957), with repeat buyers in UAE, Sri Lanka and Tanzania. The company is simultaneously a large importer of aluminium sheet/foil/micro-channel tube from China (Arconic Kunshan, Shandong Hongyuan, Shanghai Huafon, Nanning Anhe), i.e. it is a converter/manufacturer of radiators, not a pure trader. Declared HS codes 732219 and 870891: 870891 is confirmed by actual shipment records; 732219 (radiators for central heating, non-electric) does not appear in any observed row — the observed trade is automotive cooling radiators under 87089100, so per project rule 3 the code should be corrected to the factual 87089100 and the company retained (accepted_hs_corrected), not rejected. Revenue and export volume figures are not public in the free views — left null, not estimated. No sanctions/court data was checked (out of scope for this role). Domestic supply evidence remains unverified and should be re-checked against GST/GeM sources when search access is restored.
